finding.description: The architecture contract's data_loader.load_data_returns declares the training keys x_train and y_train and omits the exact four-key active-learning loader surface required by the matched build plan. Re-emit this block with exactly x_pool, y_pool, x_test, and y_test, using descriptors consistent with the scaffolded loader and the existing pool/test dimensions; preserve the rest of the contract.
finding.proposed_fix: Update arch_contract.json data_loader.load_data_returns so its key set is exactly ['x_pool', 'y_pool', 'x_test', 'y_test']; do not leave x_train or y_train in that loader-return block. Keep training inputs under training_loop.input, where the build plan separately requires x_train and y_train.

rationale: The validator explicitly enforces AL_ARCH_CONTRACT_REQUIREMENTS in scripts/build_plan.py: data_loader.load_data_returns has exact_keys x_pool, y_pool, x_test, y_test, while training_loop.input_shapes independently requires x_train and y_train. The failing artifact has the wrong loader key set but otherwise represents the declared active-learning paradigm, so the architecture-coder can repair the contract without upstream re-analysis or validator changes.
